definitions.explanation: Abbreviated form of バレーボール.
Classical dance. Also written as バレエ.

examples.japanese: {体育|たいいく}の{授業|じゅぎょう}でバレーをした。
examples.english: We played volleyball in PE class.

examples.japanese: バレー{部|ぶ}の{練習|れんしゅう}は{毎日|まいにち}ある。
examples.english: Volleyball club practice is every day.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{小|ちい}さい{頃|ころ}からバレーを{習|なら}っている。
examples.english: My daughter has been learning ballet since she was little.

notes:
バレー has two meanings depending on context.

DISTINGUISHING:
・バレー{部|ぶ} (school) → usually volleyball
・バレー{教室|きょうしつ} → usually ballet
・Context usually makes the meaning clear

SPELLING:
バレエ is often preferred when specifically referring to ballet, while バレー typically means volleyball.
